values./items/@Iqag9wwwd2eEW1mk/system/descript: A long, sharp knife designed to hack through dense or tough vegetation, the same properties that make it a useful tool also make it an effective weapon. While some machetes found in the wasteland were purpose-made blades, others are makeshift tools, typically made from a sharpened metal blade such as that salvaged from a lawnmower, bolted, tied, taped, or otherwise affixed to a simple handle.
values./items/@hCWfBvWuxYOuG6ge/system/descript: A pre-War weapon found across the wastelands and used in large numbers by various aggressive factions. Combat Rifles are a rugged and adaptable design, able to be modified to fill a variety of different battlefield roles.
values./items/@NzfcFyDRq38dSN0G/system/descript: Consisting of a glass bottle—normally from an alcoholic beverage—containing a flammable fuel mixture, a bit of motor oil to help it spread, and an alcohol-soaked rag stuffed in the top to act as a wick. When used, the wick is ignited and the bottle hurled at the target; the breaking bottle spreads the agitated mixture, which quickly ignites begins to burn anything in the vicinity. Cheap and effective.
values./items/@OyonrgKbBfEKGs50/system/descript: A raider veteran may spend a minor action to order a raider of lower level within Close range to immediately perform a minor action. Alternatively, they may spend a major action to order another raider to take a major action immediately.
values./items/@3it8u4syxeR1aE8c/system/descript: Once per combat, the raider veteran may ‘let rip’ with a volley from their Combat Rifle. This adds the weapon’s Fire Rate of 2 to the weapon’s damage for a single attack (for 7 CD total).
values./system/biography:
Raiders

There are many groups throughout the wasteland who band together for survival at any cost. The harsh life that comes with the post-nuclear apocalypse has a habit of bringing out the worst of humanity. Raider gangs often represent some of these less-than-favorable individuals. While they are not a centralized faction, with many groups waring among themselves, the ‘raider’ designation is often given to any group of people who reject the peaceful ways of most settlements and instead rely on raiding, theft, violence, and murder for their survival. They often set up settlements of their own and defend them viciously, employing both personal weapons, automated turrets and even attack dogs to keep people out. Chems use is also rampant among raider groups, which is also attributed to their increased rage, paranoia, and unpredictable behavior.

Raider Veteran

Survival in the wasteland often earns you at least a modicum of respect among your peers and that is the case for veteran raiders. The improved armor and higher-grade weaponry often point to their ability to survive and even thrive in the wasteland, making them difficult to come up against. Often both effective in combat and intelligent, they are not to be underestimated.
